text: My daily routine is simple but well organized. I usually wake up at seven o'clock and start my day with a healthy breakfast. After that, I get ready and begin work at nine. I work on my computer until noon, and then I take a short lunch break. In the afternoon, I often go for a run or do some exercise to stay active. In the evening, I cook dinner, watch a little TV, or read a book. I try to go to bed before eleven. I believe consistency is the key to a balanced and productive life.
